title: First 5 (Five) of Alameda County - Contract for Services - Kindergarten Readiness - Neighborhoods Ready for School - Summer Learning Programs - Community Schools and Student Services Department
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Contract for Services (Contract Number PI-NRS-2122-658) by and between the District and First 5 of Alameda County, Alameda, CA, with District accepting Grant Award from the latter, in the amount of $531,958.00, to support Summer Pre-K (SPK) programs and provide Early Childhood Education (ECE) and K-12 teachers with professional development and orientation to the SPK model; support a School Readiness Coordinator (Program Manager) to develop and implement year-round school readiness and transition programming including a student passport/snapshot form, a variety of family/child learning activities, and to provide financial relief to families with children 0-5 through the Oakland Educational Fund for the highest need families residing in the highest need  neighborhoods in the City of Oakland, serving all Child Development Centers (CDC) and  participating Summer Pre-K sites, for the period of July 1, 2021 through June 30, 2022, pursuant to the terms and conditions of the Contract.
funding_source: First Five of Alameda County Grant
headline: Accepts $531,958 from First 5 of Alameda County for Summer Pre-K and school readiness work
summary: The district accepts a $531,958 grant from First 5 of Alameda County. The money supports Summer Pre-K programs, training for early childhood and K-12 teachers, a School Readiness Coordinator, and financial relief for families with children ages 0-5 in the highest-need Oakland neighborhoods. It covers July 1, 2021 through June 30, 2022.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Sole Source Exception To Public Bidding - Services Agreement - COVID-19 Testing – Spartan Medical, Inc. – Office of the Chief of Staff
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Resolution 2122-0108 - Authorizing Use of Sole Source Exception to Public Bidding for a Services Agreement by and between the District and Spartan Medical, Inc., a Maryland Corporation, for the latter to provide site coordinators or medical staff (“Professionals”) at each customer site designated by OUSD to assist with District’s COVID-19 testing program to be conducted, for the period of October 13, 2021 through October 12, 2022, in an amount not-to-exceed $3,672,000.00.
headline: Pays Spartan Medical up to $3.67M for COVID-19 testing site staff, without public bidding
summary: The district hires Spartan Medical, Inc. to provide site coordinators or medical staff to help run its COVID-19 testing program, for up to $3,672,000 from October 13, 2021 through October 12, 2022. The board is using a sole source exception, which lets the district skip public bidding when it finds only one provider can do the work.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Change Order No. 1, Agreement Between Owner and Contractor - Competitively Bid – Mar Con Builders – Piedmont Avenue Elementary School Playmatting Installation Project – Division of Facilities Planning & Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Change Order No. 1, Agreement Between Owner and Contractor - District and Mar Con Builders, Oakland, CA,  for reconciliation of unused allowance for the Piedmont Elementary School Playmatting Installation Project, as a deductive change in the amount of $1,492.00, reducing the contract price from $192,000.00 to $190,508.00, and an adjustment to Contract Time In This Change Order: 271 Calendar Days, extending the term from September 11, 2020 through December 15, 2020 to September 12, 2021. All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Cuts $1,492 from Mar Con Builders' Piedmont Avenue playmatting contract; end date moves to Sept. 2021
summary: This change order reduces the contract with Mar Con Builders by $1,492, from $192,000 to $190,508, to account for an unused allowance on the playmatting installation at Piedmont Avenue Elementary School. It also extends the end date, previously December 15, 2020, to September 12, 2021, a date that had already passed when the board voted. The contract was competitively bid.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Agreement Between Owner and Contractor – Non-Competitively Bid – Rook Electric – McClymond High School Surveillance Upgrades Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of Agreement Between Owner and Contractor by and between the District and Rook Electric, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide the following repair services, replace existing wiring with Cat6e, replace analog cameras with new IP Dome cameras, reuse existing conduit, connect the new IP cameras to the nearest IDF, use existing data ports and switches, with service including all work described in the August 19, 2021, Proposal attached to Agreement as Exhibit A, in the amount of $47,380.00, which includes a contingency of $6,180.00, with work anticipated to commence on August 30, 2021, and scheduled to last for three hundred four (304) days, with an anticipated ending of June 30, 2022.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Ratifies $47,380 contract with Rook Electric to upgrade McClymonds High School cameras
summary: The board ratifies (approves after the fact) a $47,380 agreement, including a $6,180 contingency, with Rook Electric to replace old wiring and analog cameras with new IP dome cameras at McClymonds High School. The contract was not competitively bid. Work was scheduled to start August 30, 2021, before the board vote, and to last 304 days, ending around June 30, 2022.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
